Follow the rules in `AGENTS.md` at the repository root; they apply to every assistant and every contributor. The design specs in `docs/design/` are the source of truth, and `CONTRIBUTING.md` describes the workflow.

This repository is public: never add team strategy, schedules, event values, real hostnames, addresses or credentials. PowerShell code must run on Windows PowerShell 5.1, and a change the spec covers on both platforms goes into both runners with tests in bats and Pester.
